## Summary

Describe what changed and why.

## Verification

List the checks you ran and any relevant manual verification.

## Checklist

- [ ] The change is focused and does not include unrelated refactoring.
- [ ] `npm run lint` passes.
- [ ] `npm test` passes.
- [ ] `npm run build` passes.
- [ ] Tests cover new behavior or the reported regression.
- [ ] Public behavior and options are documented in both READMEs.
- [ ] Changes to safe defaults, tool names, or option names are clearly identified.
- [ ] No API keys, tokens, production URLs, or private route schemas are included.
